<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="326" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="16" x2="334" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="22" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="22" x2="352" y2="22" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="16" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="364" y="18" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="386" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,76 20,86 30,96" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="91" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Phone verification</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="113" x2="370" y2="113" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Verification content -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="164" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="30" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Enter verification code</text>
    <text x="195" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We sent a 6-digit code to</text>
    <text x="195" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">+1 (415) 555-0184</text>

    <!-- Code entry -->
    <line x1="47" y1="267" x2="87" y2="267" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="105" y1="267" x2="145" y2="267" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="163" y1="267" x2="203" y2="267" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="221" y1="267" x2="261" y2="267" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="279" y1="267" x2="319" y2="267" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="267" x2="377" y2="267" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="67" y="256" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="24" fill="#4A4A4A">8</text>
    <text x="195" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Code expires in 09:42</text>

    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="326" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
      <text x="195" y="354" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="414" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Didn't get a code?</text>
    <text x="195" y="440" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">RESEND CODE</text>
    <line x1="145" y1="445" x2="245" y2="445" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You can also edit your phone number</text>
  </g>

  <!-- iOS numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="564" width="390" height="280" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="564" x2="390" y2="564" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <rect x="8" y="573" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="573" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="573" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <text x="67" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="195" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="323" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>
    <text x="195" y="620" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">ABC</text>

    <rect x="8" y="636" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="636" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="636" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <text x="67" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="195" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="323" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
    <text x="195" y="683" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">JKL</text>

    <rect x="8" y="699" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="699" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="699" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <text x="67" y="729" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="195" y="729" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="323" y="729" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
    <text x="195" y="746" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">WXYZ</text>

    <rect x="8" y="762" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="762" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="762" width="118" height="56" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <text x="195" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <circle cx="323" cy="790" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="796" x2="337" y2="804" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <polyline points="56,791 64,799 78,780" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <rect x="151" y="828" width="88" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
